cells.gaps: The two facts on the 2025-2029 policy disagree: the minister said in July 2025 that the Council of Ministers approved it earlier in 2025 (SOM-019), while a notice of 11 November 2025 seeks consultants to renew the 2019-2024 policy as a 2025-2029 one (SOM-001). No text of the 2025-2029 policy has been found, nor any delivery plan or report against it; no body is recorded inside the 36 months and the only finance is an IDA grant for the renewal consultancy.
cells.note: National ICT Policy and Strategy 2025-2029: recorded as adopted by the Council of Ministers in 2025, but nobody has found its text, so it stops at stage 2 and not 3. The 2019-2024 policy it replaces ended in 2024 and would place the cell at the same rung, as an ended policy with a successor in preparation.
